profile.perfume: Chanel Allure Homme Sport Eau de Toilette
profile.baseline_state: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE / ZERO EMPIRICAL SIMILARITY PASS
profile.official_summary: Italian mandarin, clean intense cedar, almondy tonka and enveloping white musk balance freshness and sensuality.
profile.target_identity: Sparkling mandarin and open-air freshness crossing a clean cedar spine into almond-tonka and skin-like white musk.
profile.hedonic_tension: Outdoor kinetic freshness versus soft bare-skin sensuality.
profile.authority_note: Official notes constrain modules, not molecules or proportions.

art_direction.primary_motif: A juicy mandarin arc thrown through open air onto clean cedar.
art_direction.secondary_motif: Almond-tonka warmth and a radiant white-musk skin trail.
art_direction.foreground: Mandarin peel, moving air, watery floral lift and clean cedar.
art_direction.background: Green seam, almond softness, sandalwood fibers and musk skin.
art_direction.tension: Outdoor kinetic freshness versus bare-skin sensuality.
art_direction.release: The air collapses inward into cedar, then cedar softens into tonka and skin musk.
art_direction.negative_space: Marine materials stay below the point of blue-fragrance identity; floral-air materials carve space between citrus and cedar.
art_direction.recurrence: Mandarin returns in the drydown as a warm peel echo inside tonka and white musk.
art_direction.texture_progression: sparkling peel → wind on skin → clean cedar → almond cream → luminous musk
art_direction.spatial_identity: Bright kinetic opening in the far field, with softer cedar-tonka detail close to skin.
art_direction.late_residue: Dry cedar, almond-tonka, sandalwood fibers and a clean metallic-soft musk blend.
art_direction.controlled_imperfection: A green-bitter petitgrain seam keeps the sporty cleanliness from becoming shower-gel polish.
art_direction.hedonic_hypothesis: Pleasure comes from motion, cleanliness with texture, and the transition from public energy to private skin.
layers: Mandarin proxy citrus, bitter peel, aldehydes and terpene lift create speed.
Helional, cyclamen, floralozone, trace Calone and muguet air create outdoor volume.
Verdox, verdyl acetate, leaf/stem traces and galbanum prevent a hollow top-to-base jump.
Natural cedars, Cedramber, Iso E, vetiver and Cashmeran make clean athletic structure.
Coumarin, tonka, heliotrope, anisic traces and restrained vanilla soften the wood.
Habanolide, Zenolide, Exaltolide, Ambrettolide and Musk Ketone split radiance, softness and persistence.
hedonic_tuning: No Galaxolide or Romandolide fog: the musk envelope is built from cleaner, more differentiated geometries.
Marine volume is used as air, not as a melon-water note.
Cedar is distributed across natural, transparent and creamy routes so the fragrance has grain and body.
Tonka is deliberately below the level of syrup or play-dough.

missing_chemical_impact.candidate: Red Mandarin EO / verified Italian mandarin lot
missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: Blood orange, generic orange peel and bergamot do not preserve the same mandarin peel/juice profile and official identity.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: The opening becomes generic citrus or cleaner-bright rather than succulent sporty mandarin.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Sweet orange candy, terpene harshness or rapid top-heavy collapse.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Current citrus build versus verified mandarin at matched total citrus load, scored at 0, 5, 15 and 30 min.
missing_chemical_impact.owned_functional_coverage: Bergamot, lemon, grapefruit, orange peel and citrus modifiers
missing_chemical_impact.purchase_or_prepare: Replenish a verified mandarin lot before claiming exact AHS opening.

missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: Not applicable: the inventory already has multiple clean, macrocyclic, powdery and metallic musk geometries.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: No loss from omitting another generic musk; architecture and ratios matter more.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Laundry fog, anosmia-dependent holes and loss of cedar/tonka detail.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Habanolide-led, Zenolide/Exaltolide-soft and Galaxolide-supported architectures at equal perceived musk load.
missing_chemical_impact.owned_functional_coverage: Habanolide, Zenolide, Exaltolide, Musk Ketone, Tonalide, Galaxolide; Ambrettolide design-available

interaction_map.expected_effect: Citrus gives the air field recognizable peel and kinetic brightness.
interaction_map.failure_mode: Aquatic cleaner or fleeting terpene flash.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Watery floral and ozonic materials carry freshness into clean cedar.
interaction_map.failure_mode: Generic blue top placed above a static base.
interaction_map.physical_test: Air-block ablation; score continuity at 5–120 min.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Leaf/stem and green-fruit traces preserve peel and outdoor motion.
Almond-tonka softens dry cedar and turns sport freshness toward skin.
Differentiated musks extend cedar as an enveloping skin aura.
interaction_map.physical_test: Musk geometry A/B at matched active load.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Marine/clean-musk overlap can create shower-gel genericity.
Floral, ionone and natural traces make tonka feel tactile rather than simple sweetness.
A warm peel echo should recur inside tonka and musk.
Musk can conceal cedar grain if overbuilt.
interaction_map.physical_test: −20% musk / +20% cedar control at 8 and 24 h.

test_plan.primary_comparison: Full Mandarin Air / Cedar Skin versus no-air bridge, low/high musk geometry, and exact Italian mandarin comparator.
pass_criteria: no aquatic melon or blue shower gel
white musk envelops without laundry fog

temporal_test.core_time_question: Does mandarin memory remain as cedar-tonka-musk takes over?
